items.text: Full and part loads to Germany, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia and Austria, on dates you agree with us.

items.title: Certified quality
items.text: EPAL-branded pallets, heat-treated to ISPM 15 and checked before every dispatch.

items.title: One contact, fast answers
items.text: A personal account manager who replies within one business day — in your language.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: We usually deliver from one pallet stack (about 15–20 pallets) upwards. For full truckloads (around 600 pallets) we offer the best price per piece.

items.q: Do you sell used pallets as well as new ones?
items.a: Yes. Besides new EPAL pallets we offer sorted used pallets in grade A (light, clean, like new) and grade B (darker, fully functional).
Items in stock usually leave our yard within 48 hours. Delivery time then depends on the destination — we confirm the exact date with your quote.

items.q: Do pallet collars fit every Euro pallet?
items.a: Our collars are made for the standard 1200 × 800 mm EPAL format and fit any pallet built to that standard.

items.q: Can you take our used pallets back?
items.a: Pallet exchange or buy-back is possible in many cases. Tell us your volumes in the form and we will suggest an option.

cookies.analyticsText: Anonymous statistics about visits. Off unless you allow it.

sections.p: WAV Invest is responsible for the personal data processed on this website. You can reach us at the contact details in the footer.

When you send the quote form we receive your name, company, email, phone number and the details of your request. We use them only to answer your request and prepare an offer (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The form is delivered to us by email through the service Web3Forms. We keep the data for as long as needed for the business relationship and legal retention periods.

We set a necessary cookie to remember your language (NEXT_LOCALE) and one to remember your cookie choice (wav_consent). Analytics cookies are only set if you allow them, and you can change your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer.
You have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the processing of your data, to data portability and to object. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.
